description: A double-ended queue with constant-time appends and pops at both ends and an optional `maxlen`.
A dict subclass for counting. Missing keys read as 0; supports `most_common`, `update` and arithmetic.
A dict that creates a value with a factory when a missing key is read, and stores it.
A view over several mappings searched in order. Writes go to the first mapping.
`deque(maxlen=n)` drops the oldest item when a new one arrives past the limit.
